claims.finding: Strict trees; local matrix or TRS; parent-global × local, with nonjoint ancestors included. Double precision SHOULD for local/global calculation. Explicit scale may be zero, so an optional inverse-output transform cannot be assumed invertible.

Skin-local order; omitted inverseBindMatrices => identity. Present accessor MAT4/float32, count≥joints, associated matrices finite and fourth row [0,0,0,1]. Bind-shape may be baked into geometry or IBM.

Column-major storage. MAT4 FLOAT element is64 bytes. IBM is not vertex attribute data: no byteStride/target; final elements after source resolution and sparse replacement are consumed. Do not import vertex interleaving assumptions.
Skeleton optional common ancestor/pivot; not required to compute transforms and not an extra multiplier. Joint common root may be nonjoint and must be in same scene as skinned instance.
Same mesh may use different skins; ordinary primitive separate; world-output weighted joint-global × IBM; mesh node global not applied again. All-zero influence has no usable transformation.
Mesh branch nodes1/2 rotation/scale excluded from skinning; joint branch nodes3/4 translation/scale contribute; skeleton0 does not itself define a separate formula factor.
POSITION/NORMAL/TANGENT morph displacements precede skinning/node transforms. Proposed method either excludes active morph or receives already evaluated source-space position; not a morph tutorial.

claims.locator: From effective-matrix formula, assuming invertible chosen output transform H
claims.finding: K_local=H^-1 G_j B_j and final H cancel to world K. This is an algebraic adapter, not glTF missing factor, engine execution, or claim about a named renderer.
G_bind=T_x(2), B=T_x(-2), G_current=T_x(2)R_z(90deg), p=(3,0,0,1): correct=(2,1,0,1); reversed B G=(0,3,0,1). Proposed hand-computable test, not executed code/asset.

method_design: Preserve current node/skin/pose/output-frame identity while pairing each j with its skin-local IBM and global joint node.
Build G over the complete valid node tree, not just the joints array; then C=G B.
A different output frame requires an explicit invertible H and H^-1 adapter, with actual downstream H preserved; not a hidden glTF factor or tested engine API.
Finite values, budgets and chosen precision are implementation gates, not a universal numerical tolerance.
Keep inherited FLOAT-weight diagnostics; do not silently normalize or divide homogeneous w to hide them.
Translation, noncommuting rotation and two hierarchy arrangements are original bounded mathematics, not imported sample runs.
